children: Renesas Electronics is expanding its India footprint, with the semiconductor major crossing 1,000 employees in the country and planning new operations in Pune as it looks to deepen its work in automotive, industrial, and physical AI applications.

The company has a presence in Hyderabad, Bengaluru and Noida, with a Pune office set to open later this year, according to Malini Narayanamoorthi, President of Renesas Electronics India and Vice President, Renesas. Pune is being positioned as a strategic location for the company’s automotive business.
“We’ll do a fair bit of our solutions and system development for automotive from Pune,” Narayanamoorthi added.
The company addresses sectors such as automotive, industrial and IoT. Of late, EV two-wheelers and four-wheelers are emerging as a key area for India-led innovation.

title: Renesas crosses 1,000 employees in India, expands footprint with Pune office
